snippet.title: Sharp X1 Game: Rally-X (1985)
snippet.description:
Rally-X was one of Namco's first video games to be exported outside Japan, due to their business relations with Midway. You control a small car running around in a maze. What you have to is to pick up the ten flags to get more points. While you try to collect the flags you are chased by hostile cars that try to crash your car. So dodge them by using your smoke screen. Other factors to take into account are a time limit, fuel gauge and that some roads are blocked by an rock!

Please like this video and subscribe to my channel for more great retro content.
